about.title: About HooperZone
about.lead: HooperZone is an online store specialising in sports and medical supports, braces and compression wear.

p: HooperZone was started by athletes and health enthusiasts who have been through injuries and the road back to sport themselves. We want buying a knee brace, wrist support or back belt to be simple, reliable and free of guesswork.
Every product is genuine and comes with an authenticity guarantee.
For each product we explain in plain words what it is for, how much support it gives and how to pick a size.
You can ask our team for advice on the right product and size before you buy.
Orders ship across Iran by Post and Tipax and come with a 7-day return guarantee.
Our products are designed for support and prevention and do not replace a doctor's examination or diagnosis. With severe pain, swelling or an acute injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: Get in touch for advice before you buy, help with an order, or anything else.
contact.orderHelp: Please have your order number ready. Order status and the parcel tracking code are also shown under “My orders”.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.lead: After successful payment, orders are usually packed and handed to the carrier within one business day.

p: At checkout you choose registered Post, Post Pishtaz or Tipax, and the shipping fee is added to your order there.
Delivery time counts from the day after the parcel is handed to the carrier and may be longer during holidays and for remote cities.
Once shipped, the parcel tracking code appears on your order page so you can follow it on the Post or Tipax website.
Check the package when it arrives. If it is damaged, note it with the courier before accepting it and let us know.

returns.title: Returns
returns.lead: If a product isn't right for you, you can request a return within 7 days of delivery.

p: The item is unused, clean and returned with its original packaging, labels and accessories.
The return is requested within 7 days of delivery.
For hygiene reasons, items worn directly on the skin (such as socks and compression wear) can only be returned unopened.
Contact us by the phone or email on the Contact page with your order number and the reason.
After we confirm, send the item to the store address by Post.
Once we receive and check it (within 2 business days), the refund reaches your bank account within 3–7 business days.
If an item is faulty or not what you ordered, HooperZone pays the return shipping and replaces it or refunds you in full.
If the size doesn't fit, you can request an exchange within the same 7 days. In that case the customer pays the shipping for the replacement.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.lead: By using the HooperZone website and placing orders you accept the terms below. They follow the e-commerce laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

p: Ordering requires an account with a valid mobile number. You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for activity on your account.
The details you enter when registering and ordering must be accurate and complete.
Prices are in Toman and include VAT where applicable. Shipping is shown separately before you pay.
Payment is made only through secure bank gateways (ZarinPal) with Shetab cards. HooperZone never receives or stores your card details.
Orders not paid within the set time are cancelled automatically.
Placing an order is not final confirmation. If we cannot ship an item for any reason, we will contact you and refund any payment in full.
If a price is shown incorrectly because of a technical error, HooperZone may cancel the order and refund you.
Until it ships, you can cancel your order under “My orders” or by contacting support. Paid amounts are refunded within 3–7 business days.
Product information is for guidance only and does not replace medical advice. Consult a doctor before using medical supports for an acute injury.
Please raise any dispute with our support first. If it cannot be resolved, the competent courts of the Islamic Republic of Iran have jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: We take your personal data seriously. This page explains what we collect and how we use it.

p: Your name, mobile number, email (optional) and shipping address, entered when you register and order.
Your order history, favourites and the reviews you post.
To process and ship orders, send SMS verification codes and update you on your order.
To answer support requests and improve the store.
We never sell your data. Only your name, address and phone number are given to the carrier (Post or Tipax) to deliver your parcel.
Payment happens on the bank gateway; your card details never reach HooperZone.
The site is served over HTTPS and your password is stored encrypted.
You can edit your details on your profile page, or contact support to delete your account.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Answers to common questions about ordering, shipping and choosing a product.

items.q: How do I choose the right size?
items.a: Each product page has a size guide. Measure around the joint (for example the knee or wrist) with a tape and compare with the chart. If you are between sizes, ask our support.
Orders usually ship one business day after payment. Delivery depends on the method: Tipax 1–3, Post Pishtaz 2–4 and registered Post 3–7 business days.
The fee for each method is shown on the Shipping page and at checkout.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Sign in and open “My orders”. Once shipped, the parcel tracking code is shown there too.
Yes. Payment happens only on the ZarinPal bank gateway and your card details never reach HooperZone.

items.q: What if the product doesn't suit me?
items.a: Within 7 days of delivery you can return an unused item or exchange the size. See the Returns page for details.
No. Supports help with stability and prevention, but for acute injuries you should see a doctor or physiotherapist.
